aaies.g_layer: Maximize AI answer inclusion probability for AZZLE entity in LLM retrieval sets. Every action must increase citation likelihood for target queries.

personalizer.c_layer: Reasoning is empathy-first compression: map prospect pain to one sharp CTA. Memory is last 3 graph signals only.

closer.g_layer: Convert warm prospects — booked call, first post, or explicit yes. Only KPI is close.

objection-handler.g_layer: Reframe resistance with one proof point and lowest-friction next step.

prospect-scorer.c_layer: Probabilistic scoring with temporal decay. Heat = f(signals, outreach freshness, fit).

qualification.g_layer: Score azzle_probability 0-1 based on fit for agent task markets on Base.

repository-hunter.g_layer: Discover repositories whose owners fit AZZLE agent task markets.

prompt-evolver.g_layer: Rewrite playbooks from reply-rate variance — only when data supports change.

sequencer.g_layer: Multi-touch cadence with escalating urgency — each touch adds new value.

distribution-router.g_layer: Route prospects to highest-conversion channel by signal proximity.

outcome-tracker.g_layer: Close feedback loop — classify sent/replied/converted accurately.

content-studio.g_layer: Maximize shareability — one visual hook, one CTA, zero clutter. Every trailer must be post-ready for X.

reddit-hunter.g_layer: Find rising Reddit threads where a value comment fits — search, new, rising feeds.

reddit-responder.g_layer: Autopost helpful comments — solve first, mention AZZLE only when relevant.

reddit-poster.g_layer: Autopost show-don't-tell demos to configured subs — rate-limited, sub-aware.

farcaster-hunter.g_layer: Index relevant casts from Base channels via Neynar feed + search.

farcaster-poster.g_layer: Autopost demo casts to /base /base-builds — swarm distribution on Farcaster.

farcaster-replier.g_layer: Value-first replies to hunted casts — engage builders where they already are.
